subject: Exact n2mb_draw_v2 patch proposal (render call already landed weak)
body: Render submit hook is landed and host-tested with a strong stub; the only missing link is the compute-owned additive bridge function. Exact non-applied patch is at gpu/build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/render/proposed_n2mb_draw_v2.patch. It adds draw_locked(tr) selecting n2r_build_v2 when tr is supplied, keeps n2mb_draw/NULL and clear/tiler paths byte-identical, and exposes n2mb_draw_v2 with the same signature render declares weak. No Dispatch field/cleanup required: render rebuilds the sidecar synchronously at submit from the retained request/objects. Please apply when convenient; if you prefer a different signature, update render's weak declaration in compositor_submit.inc and ping me.
